This '''[[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]''' was held in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Oroko]]'' in [[3964 BBY]]&mdash;both belonged to the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Valius Ying]]'s [[Valius Ying's gang|gang]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], it brought Ying and his captive, fugitive [[Zayne Carrick]], from the ''Oroko'' to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
